correctness.rationale: The conditional variance evolution gives the exact normalized effective-stiffness stationary law (the original source agrees). Gamma-mixture substitution and chi strong-law coupling prove the density. A quadratic discriminant and root-location analysis exhaust all limiting modes including alpha=2 and the two double-root endpoints. Local differentiable concentration of the log-chi kernel proves C1 convergence away from support endpoint; a four-point derivative sign argument establishes at least two strict separated finite-dimensional radial maxima for all sufficiently large d. The standalone checker reproduces symbolic derivatives, transform Jacobians, normalization, and a direct conditional-chi numerical witness. No finite experiment is used as proof of the universal assertions.

value.rationale: Euclidean radial concentration is a natural experimentally interpretable observable. The result provides two unexpected disconnected rate windows for bimodality of a high-dimensional radial histogram, despite monotone vector spatial density, with sharp algebraic boundaries and genuine persistence at large but finite dimensions. It classifies a physical shape effect, not an arbitrary parameter substitution or a routine known-table recomputation.
